CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS acp_plan_completions (
source TEXT NOT NULL,schedule_id TEXT NOT NULL,run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
project_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(project_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('started','failed')),
task_id TEXT CHECK(task_id IS NULL OR length(task_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
error TEXT CHECK(error IS NULL OR length(error)<=2048),
CHECK((status='started' AND task_id IS NOT NULL AND error IS NULL) OR (status='failed' AND error IS NOT NULL)),
PRIMARY KEY(source,run_id),FOREIGN KEY(source,run_id) REFERENCES acp_plan_runs(source,run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE) STRICT;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS acp_completion_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF status,task_id,error ON acp_plan_runs
WHEN NEW.status IN ('started','failed') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM acp_plan_completions c WHERE c.source=NEW.source AND c.run_id=NEW.run_id AND (c.status!=NEW.status OR c.task_id IS NOT NEW.task_id OR c.error IS NOT NEW.error))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'ACP completion intent conflicts with outcome'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS acp_completion_cleanup AFTER UPDATE OF status ON acp_plan_runs
WHEN NEW.status IN ('started','failed') BEGIN DELETE FROM acp_plan_completions WHERE source=NEW.source AND run_id=NEW.run_id; END;
